trainingMix: 50% current RL, 25% historical RL, 25% fast native heuristics; balanced starting seats
slowHeuristics: Native Money held out from synchronous rollout collection and evaluated separately with independent whole-game workers; no approximated Money policy
selection: Highest screening tie-adjusted share, then outright wins; compare incumbent and both checkpoints on same screening seeds
promotion: Candidate paired 95% lower bound on share improvement > 0 on 1536 fresh reference games; no observed per-reference-opponent share regression greater than 3 percentage points; must also pass 256-game matched native Money guard with observed share regression no greater than 3 points. Guard is a regression screen, not proof of 3-point statistical noninferiority.
final: Freeze after round two; 3072 fresh reference games per leader for v1 versus selected champion, and final current-model cross-play. All final games replay verified; no exclusions.
production: Do not replace shipped weights until independent final evidence supports promotion
seeds: league-v1:<leader>:<namespace>:<index>, disjoint train/screen/confirm/final namespaces; same seeds between candidate and incumbent
concurrency: Two learners with eight environment workers each; independent whole-game workers for expensive native guard
